In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the poroelastic properties of cement paste, in the ideal drained case and for a given water-to-cement ration, can be evaluated using the homogeneization model and the results of a macroscopic laboratory testing.
the homogenization technique is a useful tool for evaluation of the poromechanical properties of cement paste, and it can provide the complete set of the poro-elastic parameters of a cement paste.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the poroelastic properties of cement paste are strongly dependent on its active porosity.
a macro-scale experimental investigation can be used for the evaluation of poroelastic properties of a hardened cementitious composite.
the experimental and modelling results are in good agreement and the homogenization technique is an appropriate tool for the evaluation of poroelastic properties of cement pastes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to properly model the poroelastic properties of cement paste, the notion of active porosity must be taken into account.
the porosity of a cement paste is not the same as the porosity of the solid skeleton of the cement paste.
the poroelasticity parameters of a cement paste can be evaluated using a single macroscopic experiment.
